# Economic Times

> > India's leading business and economic news platform covering pharma, manufacturing, education, and regional business developments.

Economic Times provides comprehensive coverage across multiple sectors including pharmaceutical industry news (drug approvals, API exports, regulatory updates), manufacturing and semiconductor developments, education excellence initiatives, and regional business news from across India. The platform serves as a critical resource for business intelligence, industry trends, and economic policy updates.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical Industry
- Drug Development & Approvals
- US FDA Regulatory Updates
- Active Pharma Ingredients (API)
- Semiconductor Manufacturing
- GSK & Major Pharma Companies
- Clinical Research
- India Manufacturing
- Education Technology
- Regional Business Development
- Steel Industry
- Clean Energy
- Industrial AI
- Plasma Medicines
- State Government Initiatives

## Pharmaceutical Industry & Healthcare

- [ET Pharma: Pharma News | Latest Pharma Sector Information and Updates](https://pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com/?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block): Homepage for pharma sector news covering GSK, US FDA, drug approvals & updates
- [India Surpasses Pharmaceutical Imports with Record API Exports of Rs 41,500 Crore](https://pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/pharma-industry/indias-exports-of-active-pharma-ingredients-at-rs-41500-cr-surpassed-imports-in-fy25/129410371): India's API exports reach Rs 41,500 crore, exceeding imports in FY25
- [From Pilot to Plant Floor: Industrial AI Moves from Boardroom to Assembly Line](https://pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/pharma-industry/from-pilot-to-plant-floor-industrial-ai-moves-from-boardroom-to-assembly-line/129449788): Industrial AI adoption in India factories with Rockwell Automation insights
